abstract: A standard and a step-by-step procedure for producing every Wugweb piece in two tracks: client work (case studies, portfolio, showcase) and Wugweb's own content (blog posts, service pages, site copy), plus the social, deck, Behance and Dribbble forms of either. Evidence-led and proposal-only: nothing is invented and nothing is written or posted without the owner's approval. Voice, layout, search and planning rules belong to sibling skills; this skill applies them. Changes to stored data and sync runs belong to wugweb-engineer. Independent of CMS, host and agent.
status: Part 1 locked at 0.5.0, 2026-11-17; the plan is approved by the owner. No matter is open with the owner; one is shared with wugweb-kits, listed in references/open-items.md. Evals run and graded 2026-11-17. Part 2 (site code) goes straight to main, each step on the owner's go. Review fixes applied 2026-11-19, still 0.5.0 at the owner's word.
